- [What is a Reefer Jacket? Why This Classic Should Be in Your Closet](https://trendyleatherjackets.com/what-is-a-reefer-jacket-why-this-classic-should-be-in-your-closet/): A reefer jacket is a short-length coat jacket with a double breasted closure made from heavy wool or wool blend. It includes broad lapels, buttons embossed with anchors, and a fitted outline. The practical design provides extra warmth and allows for ease of movement. The term ‘reefer’ is derived from the Dutch word “reifer,” which means short and heavy jacket worn by the sailors. It also referred to sailors who climbed the rigging on sailing ships.
